### Job description and tailoring
Posting text came from **Tether’s careers site** mirror ([Expansion Manager – Tokenization](https://careers.tether.io/o/expansion-manager-tokenization-100-remote-6)): Hadron/RWA tokenization, client onboarding, institutional partnerships, coordination across business/product/technology, milestones and reporting, memos and proposals, travel, capital markets depth, structured/analytical profile, blockchain/fintech interest. Resume bullets weave those themes into facts already on **Zhao-Yanbo’s master** (OSL RWAs/crypto settlement; Amber BD/MM and dashboards; Huatai FICC; China Life FI; Guotai IBD diligence). No new employers, dates, or metrics were added.

### One-page resume (your override)
The full six-role/four-bullet layout produced **two pages** (same density as the existing HSBC packet). To reach **exactly one page** without touching margins or list spacing: removed **one bullet** from each role after the first two (Huatai, China Life, Guotai, and the former sixth role before it was dropped); **dropped the oldest role (Evalueserve)** with a `%` comment before **Extracurricular Activities**; tightened extracurricular lines to **≤15 words**. Rebuild was checked with **`mutool info`** → **Pages: 1** for the resume PDF.

### Builds and environment
- Compiled with: `python3 scripts/generate_job_package.py --person Zhao-Yanbo --company Tether-Io --role Expansion-Manager-Tokenization-100-Remote-In-Hong-Kong-SAR --job-url "https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4404580379/"` (after installing TeX Live on the agent host; `python` alone was not on `PATH`, so `python3` was used).

### Blockers
- **LinkedIn:** the listing was not used as the textual source of the JD because unauthenticated fetches are unreliable; wording was aligned using the **official Tether careers posting** for the same role.
- **Pagination trade-off:** the tailored resume **omits Evalueserve** and uses **three bullets** for Huatai, China Life, and Guotai so the PDF stays on one page while **OSL and Amber each keep four bullets**, as you specified.
